title: How to record mentor time
passage:
CLAYMORE DESIGN | Mentor time sheet note

The company reimburses teams for time mentors spend teaching new staff. Use the teaching code when the mentor explains a task, demonstrates it, or watches the trainee do it and provides feedback. If the trainee watches the mentor complete ordinary work without an explanation, the mentor should record the time as regular work. The trainee can still count that observation toward the orientation requirement.

For paired sessions, each mentor records only the time they personally taught. If another mentor takes over partway through, put the other person's name in the handover field, but don't include their time in your total. Neither person needs to create a second entry for the handover itself.

When a time sheet is already approved, do not change its original entry. Send the payroll desk a note with the session date and the amount to move from one code to the other. The note corrects the category; it does not change the total hours.

克萊莫設計｜導師工時表須知

公司會補償各團隊導師用來教導新進員工的工時。導師講解工作、示範，或觀察受訓者操作並提供回饋時，請使用教學代碼。如果受訓者只是觀察導師處理日常工作，導師沒有講解，就應把時間登記為一般工作。受訓者仍可把這段觀察時間計入入職訓練要求。

兩位導師共同負責的課程，每人只記自己實際教學的時間。如果另一位導師在中途接手，把對方的名字填入交接欄，但不要把對方的時間加進自己的總時數。兩人都不必專為交接另建一筆紀錄。

工時表一旦核准，就不要修改原始登記。請把課程日期與需從一個代碼轉到另一個代碼的時數寫成備註，送交薪資承辦。這份備註用來更正分類，不會改變總工時。
